mainText: Hello, Verona! At 9 AM, we are seeing 56 degrees with some light rain near the Military Ridge State Trail.

The city has released sample ballots for the November 3rd election. Residents can confirm their ward and polling place details by visiting the My Vote Wisconsin website or by contacting the city clerk office.
Today you can enjoy Yoga at Insight Wellness or head to Hop Haus Brewing for trivia tonight. Tomorrow, look forward to live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard and the Wisconsin Brewing Company.
On October 10, the Verona Police Department responded to a call in the 100 block of Prairie Oaks Drive where they took a 24-year-old man into custody for an outstanding arrest warrant.
The Culver's flavor of the day is the delicious Crazy for Cookie Dough. The restaurant is currently closed but will open today at 10:00 AM.
